note:
The size this atlas has already reached, per measure. The build FAILS if any of these goes backwards.

Every bug this project has shipped to the public site was a silent SHRINKAGE, not a crash. build-surnames.py read the family archives through a path CI does not have, so the deployed dataset lost every archive attestation — Lerena lost Argentina and Uruguay, Defranceski lost Croatia — and eleven builds went green over the top of it. A gate that only asks «is the file there» cannot see that. A gate that asks «is it still as big as it was» can.

A floor is not a target. Raise one only when a real gain has been verified, with scripts/raise-floors.py, and never to make a failing build pass.
